sd_library.name: KONTAKTS SD Application Library
sd_library.description: Current widgets, Platform 0.4.0 system Help and offline UPDATE content, including the physically accepted Climate Controller SD package. Download the complete ZIP and extract it into the root of the FAT32 SD card; do not flash it to ESP32.

firmwares.name: KONTAKTS Platform / Climate Controller + Web
firmwares.description: Current physically accepted KONTAKTS Platform for ESP32-8048S043. Adds the App18 Climate Controller for EID041 temperature/humidity + MA01 DO1..DO4 over shared Modbus RTU, configurable hysteresis, 60-second stale-data grace, FAILSAFE behavior, SD HMI, and responsive local browser control at /climate through the common command/service layer. AUTO ON reserves MA01 for climate control; AUTO OFF releases external relay control.

firmwares.name: KONTAKTS Platform / BLE + Web + MA01
firmwares.description: Previous physically accepted KONTAKTS Platform 0.3.9 for ESP32-8048S043. Keep this as the immediate rollback/reference release before Platform 0.4.0.

firmwares.name: KONTAKTS Platform Stable
firmwares.description: Known-good recovery baseline. Use only when the current platform cannot be recovered through the normal 0.4.0/0.3.9 paths.

sd_applications.name: Clock
sd_applications.description: NTP seven-segment clock package. Used to prove that manifest-driven SD discovery is independent of YouTube-specific firmware.

sd_applications.name: Weather
sd_applications.description: Three-entrypoint weather demonstration package (Current, Today, 7 Day Forecast). Current package uses static demo data for SD-only discovery and launcher testing.

sd_applications.name: YouTube
sd_applications.description: YouTube dashboard, views and subscribers entrypoints using the platform YouTube service; API secrets remain in NVS rather than on SD.

sd_applications.name: YouTube LED Carousel
sd_applications.description: Manifest-driven SD package using the generic metric carousel to rotate live YouTube/time values on physical hardware.

sd_applications.name: Modbus Controller / MA01 Control Center
sd_applications.description: SD package with Modbus T/RH monitor and MA01 Control Center. Uses the platform modbus provider; MA01 field traffic is UART1 GPIO17/18 through an external automatic-direction RS485 transceiver.

sd_applications.name: Climate Controller
sd_applications.description: Temperature and humidity regulator for EID041 + MA01 with live status, editable limits/hysteresis and AUTO ON/OFF through the common climate service.

sd_applications.name: USB Serial Terminal
sd_applications.description: USB Serial Monitor and Advanced Serial Terminal with ASCII/HEX, line-ending selection, history/repeat and fullscreen keyboard overlay.

arduino_ide.name: Arduino IDE / ESP32_8048S043 BSP
arduino_ide.status: SEPARATE ARDUINO LINE / SAMPLE A VALIDATION
arduino_ide.description: Separate Arduino IDE development line for ESP32-8048S043. It uses the local N16R8 board profile and the ESP32_8048S043 Arduino library; it is not the KONTAKTS Platform and is not part of the ESP-IDF laboratory firmware branch.
arduino_ide.notes: Arduino CI uses Arduino CLI with esp32 core 3.3.8. Examples 01-05 are compiled in CI; multiple examples 01-14 have Sample A physical validation records, while later LVGL examples include explicit diagnostic/open boundaries.

mobile_clients.name: KONTAKTS Mobile / BLE Control
mobile_clients.description: Native Android BLE client for KONTAKTS Platform 0.3.9. Uses FFF0 / FFF1 WRITE / FFF2 READ and the common command/service layer; physically validated through real Ebyte MA01 relay ON/OFF.
